# Theme Park Co-Pilot
> AI-powered Disney theme park planning. Personalized daily schedules, live wait time awareness, and proactive re-routing so families spend less time waiting and more time making memories.

## About
Theme Park Co-Pilot is an iPhone app for planning and navigating Disney theme park days — currently in private beta testing, with a live web version. It generates a personalized schedule before the trip, then works as an in-park copilot: monitoring live wait times, watching Lightning Lane return windows, and proactively suggesting re-routes around crowds and closures — like a brilliant friend who knows every wait time, shortcut, and secret. Trip leaders plan and optimize; everyone in the party follows along with a shared view of the day.

## Product
- App: https://app.themeparkcopilot.com/app.html
- Landing page: https://themeparkcopilot.com
- Platform: iPhone
- Availability: private beta testing (TestFlight); the web version is live now
- Planning support now: Disneyland and Disney California Adventure
- In development: Walt Disney World, then Universal Orlando — the blog already publishes full Walt Disney World guides (below)

## Blog
The Theme Park Co-Pilot blog publishes expert guides for Disney theme park planning, checked against Disney's official sources and updated when Disney changes prices, policies, or procedures. Topics: Disneyland, Walt Disney World, Lightning Lane, rope drop strategy, dining, hotels, trip planning, character meets, height requirements, and crowd patterns.

- Blog index: https://themeparkcopilot.com/blog
- Sitemap: https://themeparkcopilot.com/sitemap.xml
